description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

The 'local_%username%' folder will be left on the system after logoff and will also be used again if the same user logs on again

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\KeepLocalDir
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
